summary: CICS online Card List screen. Displays a scrollable, paginated list of credit cards, optionally filtered by account number and/or card number. Supports forward/backward paging (PF7/PF8) through the card file and lets the user select a card from the displayed array to drill into. Pseudo-conversational via a 2000-byte COMMAREA that remembers the paging position and filter.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the (optionally filtered) first page of cards. On re-entry, evaluate the key: PF3 return to menu; PF7 page backward; PF8 page forward; Enter re-apply filter / select a row. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF7 / PF8 / ENTER

annotations.note: Paging state (first/last key on page) carried in the COMMAREA for forward/backward navigation.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save paging/filter state to the COMMAREA and CICS RETURN with the transaction id.

paragraphs.name: 1000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the card-list map: initialize the screen and its row array, set attributes and message, then transmit.

paragraphs.name: 1100-SCREEN-INIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize the map header (title/date/time) and filter fields.

paragraphs.name: 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Fill the on-screen array with the current page of card rows (account, card number, status), one entry per table slot.

paragraphs.name: 1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set display attributes for each array row (selectable, protected, highlight on error).

paragraphs.name: 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set overall screen attributes and cursor position.

paragraphs.name: 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set the informational/error message line (e.g. 'End of list', 'Top of list').

paragraphs.name: 1500-SEND-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Transmit the card-list map to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: 2000-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and validate the filter and any selected row.

paragraphs.name: 2100-RECEIVE-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the card-list map from the terminal into the filter and array fields.

paragraphs.name: 2200-EDIT-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the filter inputs (account, card) and the selected array row.

paragraphs.name: 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: If an account filter is entered, validate it is numeric / a valid 11-digit account id.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account filter, if supplied, must be a valid account number.

paragraphs.name: 2220-EDIT-CARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: If a card-number filter is entered, validate it is numeric and 16 digits.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: card-number filter, if supplied, must be a valid 16-digit card number.

paragraphs.name: 2250-EDIT-ARRAY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the row-selection input: only one row may be selected, with a valid selection character.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: exactly one card row may be selected with a valid action character.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-FORWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next page of card records forward from the current position (starting after the last key shown), applying the filter, until the page is full or end-of-file.
branches: STARTBR/READNEXT loop until page full or EOF

paragraphs.name: 9100-READ-BACKWARDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the previous page of card records backward from the current position, applying the filter, until the page is full or top-of-file.
branches: STARTBR/READPREV loop until page full or BOF

paragraphs.name: 9500-FILTER-RECORDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Apply the active account/card filter to a read record: skip records that do not match the filter so only matching cards appear in the list.
branches: IF record matches filter -> include ELSE skip

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: only cards matching the entered account/card filter are listed.

paragraphs.name: SEND-PLAIN-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a short plain-text message to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: SEND-LONG-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a longer plain-text message to the terminal.
